QA-21874 is **FAIL**, and the report is at `results/2026-10-29/QA-21874-report.md`.

- **Instagram fails by 0.01 pp.** The first post's Response Rate is 7.31%, but 21,370 engagements / 292,651 Total Followers gives 7.30%. The gap fits follower drift: the rate likely uses an earlier follower snapshot than the Insights value. That is the same pattern behind the 10-26 HBO Max fail. No known bug applies.
- **Facebook and TikTok pass.** Facebook's Response Rate shows "<0.01%", so it is a weak check.
- **Twitter and LinkedIn are N/A.** Sony Pictures Television has no posts on either channel this week.
- **Spotify News doesn't exist.** The Thursday row 1 brand isn't on the Spotify account (the same finding as 10-22), so I ran the Thursday row 2 (Sony Pictures / Sony Pictures Television). Ralph Lauren, row 3, wasn't run.

I didn't visually inspect the saved screenshots; every value came from the page DOM.
